title: SavingPro Mobile App - Savings SaaS Dashboard
palette_note: Chalky cool-grey stage and bone-white cards, fully desaturated except for two candy hues — acid chartreuse and pale lavender — which mark every active control; all other colour comes from the landscape photos.

type.note: Large light-weight display numerals ($18.300) set 4-5x the 11px grey micro-labels; two-line greeting on tight leading; no caps, no letterspacing tricks — scale alone builds hierarchy.

imagery: landscape photography cropped into rounded cards, plus frosted overlays on top of it

layout.note: Three floating phone screens on a plain grey stage; inside, every element is a maximally rounded blob and cards use notched/concave corners so tiles interlock like puzzle pieces; generous inner padding, zero rules or dividers.

style_signature: Chalky light-grey stage with pure-white blob cards whose notched concave corners let tiles interlock, punctuated by exactly two candy hues (acid chartreuse, pale lavender) and a solid-black circular FAB.

title: SkyFort - Corporate Cyber Security SaaS Website Web Design
palette_note: Ink-navy base bled with soft magenta and rust ambient blooms in the corners; one saturated electric indigo carries every CTA and eyebrow label; white text runs at three opacity steps.

type.note: Tiny letterspaced ALL-CAPS eyebrows in accent blue sit above bold sentence-case headlines; body drops to a very small light weight, opening a large optical gap between display and text.

imagery: 3D renders — a matte dark isometric diorama of servers, cloud, lock and globe

layout.note: Centred single-column marketing rhythm inside a floating dark panel inset from the page edge; feature cards are hairline-outlined translucent rectangles in strict 3-up and 4-up rows; the full-scroll thumbnail is presented as a second artboard alongside.

style_signature: Near-black navy page bled with soft magenta and rust corner glows, a matte-dark isometric 3D diorama as hero, hairline-outlined translucent feature cards, and one electric-indigo pill CTA.

title: SaaS Web Dashboard
palette_note: Two-value dark UI — pure-black canvas, charcoal cards — staged on a dusty periwinkle backdrop; violet is the single brand accent while task tags fan into flat blue, pink, coral and amber chips.

type.note: Column headers set large and light with a ghosted grey count numeral beside them; card titles semibold, body regular two steps down; no caps anywhere, no tracking.

imagery: product screenshots inside cards plus line iconography

layout.note: Four-column kanban with wide gutters; cards are borderless charcoal blocks separated only by black gaps, no dividers; one card is lifted, rotated and inverted to white over a dashed drop placeholder to stage the drag.

style_signature: Pure-black canvas with borderless charcoal cards, one violet CTA and saturated flat tag chips, staged on a dusty-lavender backdrop with a single rotated white card caught mid-drag.

title: High-density DataGrid Table for saas web app dashboard
palette_note: Near-white with a barely-there lilac wash; a single true green owns the CTA and every progress bar, while status is coded by pale tinted pills (mint, butter, lilac, peach, rose) that never exceed 15% saturation.

type.note: One text size does almost all the work — column headers, cells and pill labels differ by weight and grey value rather than scale; numerics are tabular and percentages are bolded up while units stay light.

imagery: brand favicons and flag emoji inline in cells; no photography or illustration

layout.note: Row-first grid with the table bled off three edges and a sidebar cropped at the left; hairline row separators only, no vertical rules; every status is a pill, every filter a rounded rect; presented on a slight perspective tilt with a soft depth blur at the far edge.

style_signature: Off-white spreadsheet density with hairline row rules, tinted pastel status pills as the entire colour system, inline mini progress bars under every percentage, and one saturated green reserved for the primary action.

title: Constellation - AI SaaS Startup Product Platform About Website
palette_note: Black site on a slate-violet staged backdrop; the only saturation is the blue-to-green iridescent refraction inside the 3D chrome slabs, plus a single chartreuse status dot in the eyebrow badge.

type.note: Nav and eyebrow labels in small letterspaced ALL-CAPS; headline is a medium-weight wide geometric sans at ~3x body on tight leading; body sits small, light and generously leaded — one weight family throughout.

imagery: 3D renders — iridescent chrome slabs with prismatic edge refraction

layout.note: A single hairline rule frames the whole page as an inset container; left-aligned text column against a right-side 3D stage; faint crosshair tick marks scattered as a technical registration grid; enormous black negative space.

style_signature: Pure-black page framed by one hairline container rule, sparse letterspaced caps and crosshair registration ticks, with an iridescent chrome 3D slab whose blue-green refraction is the only colour — all photographed on a slate-violet set.

title: Saas Website Design / Branding
palette_note: Full-saturation poster palette — school-bus yellow, periwinkle, bubblegum pink, cream — with dark chocolate brown standing in for black as the ink; no greys anywhere.

type.note: Ultra-bold condensed display caps (JAMBIRD, THEY LOVE IT!) scaled to fill the exact column width, paired with a small chunky bold grotesque for body; a repeating sentence-case marquee line runs edge to edge as a divider.

imagery: cartoon mascot illustration, an environmental photo of the wordmark painted on a wall, and product screenshots

layout.note: Full-bleed horizontal colour bands stacked edge to edge with no margins between them; type is justified to the band width and the mascot overlaps and breaks the letterforms; the scrolling marquee acts as the only rule.

style_signature: Edge-to-edge saturated colour bands (yellow / pink / cream), chocolate-brown ink instead of black, an ultra-condensed display cap headline justified to the full page width, and a cartoon mascot that overlaps and interrupts its letterforms.

title: Expandable Notification Toast with timer for Saas App Dashboard
palette_note: Ninety-nine percent flat neutral grey and white; a single spring green appears only in the success ring and the sliver of countdown progress bar — no other hue in the frame.

type.note: Bold near-black title against a regular mid-grey body line where only the numeral and the closing call-to-action clause are bolded back to black — weight and grey value are the sole hierarchy devices.

layout.note: One card floating dead-centre in a vast empty grey field; the card splits into a white header and an off-white footer band separated by tone alone with no rule; a drawn cursor arrow sits bottom-right to imply the interaction.

style_signature: A single soft-shadowed white card centred in an ocean of flat #E4E4E4 grey, split into two tiers by tone rather than a rule, with bold/regular weight as the entire hierarchy and one green success hue.

title: Synetica SaaS CRM - AI Finance Dashboard
palette_note: Bone-white cards on light grey with pure-black type; one radioactive spring green appears as a blurred gradient card, chart highlight bars and a single gauge dot — literally nothing else is coloured.

type.note: Very large light-weight numerals carrying a small raised superscript % glyph; labels drop to small grey regular; the display face has slightly quirky geometric terminals and a comma decimal separator (97,22).

imagery: iconography and micro data-viz only, plus one avatar photo in the AI chat

layout.note: A tight masonry of small white metric cards cropped hard by the frame so the layout runs off all four edges; every card pairs a huge number with a hairline sparkline or bar strip; a taller AI-chat panel anchors the right column.

style_signature: Bone-white metric cards with black display numerals and raised superscript percent marks, hairline micro bar-charts, one acid-green blurred gradient card as the only colour, framed by an aggressively cropped Studio Display perspective.

title: Nodus - Admin SaaS Dashboard
palette_note: Warm-grey / faintly lilac page with white panels and pure-black type; two acid accents — chartreuse delta pills and an electric violet spline plus histogram — over an otherwise wholly desaturated field.

type.note: One enormous light-weight numeral (1,395) acts as the page's visual anchor at ~8x the small grey labels; nav items are unboxed text with the active one wrapped in a solid black pill; underline is used instead of weight for the active tab.

layout.note: Full-width chart band spanning the viewport with a scrubber rail beneath it, then a filterable table below; strong horizontal banding, everything left-flush to a single margin; presented at a hard three-quarter monitor tilt.

style_signature: Desaturated warm-grey admin canvas where one enormous light-weight numeral carries the hierarchy, navigation collapses to a black pill, and chartreuse delta pills plus a violet spline over a ghosted grey histogram are the only colour.

title: Cliento: Client Portal SaaS Landing Page
palette_note: Paper-white page floated on a black presentation field; hot tangerine is the only chroma — CTAs, arrow chips, one full-bleed card — with pale sky-blue photography as the sole soft note.

type.note: High-contrast didone display with tall ascenders and very tight leading, running 4-5x body size, paired with a plain neo-grotesque for all body and UI text; the wordmark uses the same serif at a small optical size.

imagery: cloud photography fading to white, plus black-framed product screenshots as feature cards

layout.note: Two overlapping artboards on a black field marked with faint architectural grid lines; inside, a centred symmetric hero then alternating text/UI-card pairs on a loose two-column grid with large vertical gaps.

style_signature: Didone serif display over a cloud photograph on paper-white, with pure-black rounded product cards, tangerine fills, and a circular orange arrow chip welded onto the end of every black pill button.

title: Cinemaro AI – Video Editor Dashboard SaaS
palette_note: Pure-black chrome against a scarlet-and-amber cinematic frame; UI colour is limited to white, translucent charcoal glass and one electric yellow active toggle — every warm hue comes from the media itself.

type.note: Uniform medium-weight sans across every control at near-identical size; hierarchy comes from fill and opacity rather than scale; a syntax-highlighted monospace code block supplies the only typographic contrast.

imagery: full-bleed cinematic film still (astronaut) plus syntax-highlighted code

layout.note: A floating stack of translucent panels pinned to the left third over the full-bleed video frame; every control is a pill or squircle, no panel chrome or edges; a timeline rail hangs off the bottom and the whole screen is rendered on a slight perspective tilt.

style_signature: Heavily backdrop-blurred charcoal glass panels and pill controls floating over a full-bleed scarlet film still, with a single electric-yellow active toggle and a grain-flecked black surround.

title: SaaS Analytics & Admin Dashboard Management
palette_note: White app on an off-white sidebar, floated on a cool slate-blue stage; a single mid-saturation petrol blue marks the CTA, the active bar and the logo, with mint/amber/rose tinted pills for row status.

type.note: Semibold section headings only ~1.4x the body; grey ALL-CAPS-adjacent sidebar group labels ('Work', 'Others') sit small and light; numerals use tabular figures with the currency code demoted to grey.

imagery: line iconography and a single avatar photo; no illustration

layout.note: Textbook left-sidebar shell inset inside a rounded app window with margin all around; KPI region uses hairline cell dividers rather than card surfaces, then a bordered table beneath; everything left-flush on a single column grid.

style_signature: A rounded white app window inset on a slate-blue stage, hairline-divided KPI cells instead of cards, tinted pastel status pills, and one petrol-blue fill for the active bar and primary button.

title: ShipLens SaaS – AI Shipment Management Platform
palette_note: Muted duotone of deep sage-teal and warm sand, everything dusty and low-chroma, lifted only by a pale chartreuse FAB, a chartreuse count pill and tiny lime/orange map pins.

type.note: Everything — section title, tracking number, city labels — set in a thin/light weight of a wide geometric sans, so type reads as a delicate line drawing rather than as headings; scale, not weight, separates levels.

imagery: 3D render of a container ship in soft matte clay, over a stylised paper-relief world map

layout.note: One frosted card sheet rising over a full-bleed relief map, with a horizontal card carousel bleeding off both edges and a floating pill tab bar; shot at an extreme foreshortened device angle so only two-thirds of the screen is legible.

style_signature: Sage-teal and sand duotone over a paper-relief map, frosted translucent card sheets, hairline-thin light-weight type, a soft-clay 3D ship render and one pale chartreuse circular button.

title: Orriso Dashboard – AI Workspace SaaS
palette_note: Near-monochrome brushed-silver and black; saturation is quarantined into small pastel agent chips (blue, green, peach) and the motion-blurred sports photographs pinned to the canvas.

type.note: UI labels in a small light geometric sans using a two-line stacked ghost-label / value pattern inside every pill; letterspaced caps for the wordmark and section tag; the artboard content flips to a high-contrast serif to signal 'design output'.

imagery: motion-blurred sports photography as canvas thumbnails, plus product screenshots

layout.note: Every control is a free-floating translucent grey pill over an infinite canvas — no panels, no toolbars, no chrome edges; overlapping image cards and one black artboard build depth; rendered at a hard perspective tilt on a silver monitor bezel.

style_signature: Free-floating translucent grey pills carrying two-line label/value stacks over a brushed-silver void, one black artboard for content, and colour confined entirely to motion-blurred photo thumbnails.

title: Cliento: SaaS Landing Page Scroll
palette_note: White page presented on a flat saturated tangerine field ruled with a faint grid; inside, colour is limited to the same orange plus the pale blue of the cloud photograph and the multi-hue client logos.

type.note: Very high-contrast didone display with tall ascenders and tight leading at roughly 6x body size; nav, body and buttons all sit at a single small neo-grotesque size, producing one enormous typographic jump and nothing in between.

imagery: cloud photography gradient-fading into the white page, plus real client brand logos

layout.note: A browser-window artboard floated on the orange field; hero is dead-centre and perfectly symmetric, with a hairline rule separating the logo row and a very large empty band between CTA and logos.

style_signature: Symmetric didone-serif hero emerging out of a cloud photograph that dissolves into white, a black pill CTA with a welded orange arrow chip, all floated on a flat tangerine field ruled with a faint architectural grid.
